name: Aozora Tsugumi
source:
Occupation: Student

School subject: Physical education

Personality: The quiet ninth daughter who enjoys using the naginata. She is also twin sister to Tsubame. She has a habit of swinging the naginata around when she panics, and sometimes cuts through the clothes of Tsubame who is with her.

[From [url=http://mbstruth.com/katei/cha/tugu01.html]official site[/url]]
